12: static void vision_badge_usage(const char *program)
13: {
14:   printf("Usage: %s <status|run|selftest> [question]\n", program);
15:   printf("  status            probe configured device nodes\n");
16:   printf("  run <question>    execute one capture-query-feedback cycle\n");
17:   printf("  selftest          validate application contracts without hardware\n");
18: }
19: 
20: static void vision_badge_print_probe(const char *name, const char *path,
21:                                      const struct vision_badge_probe_s *probe)
22: {
23:   if (probe->available)
24:     {
25:       printf("%-8s ready    %s\n", name, path);
26:     }
27:   else
28:     {
29:       printf("%-8s pending  %s (errno=%d)\n", name, path,
30:              probe->error_code);
31:     }
32: }
33: 
34: static int vision_badge_status(void)
35: {
36:   struct vision_badge_probe_s camera = {0};
37:   struct vision_badge_probe_s audio = {0};
38: 
39:   camera_service_probe(&camera);
40:   audio_service_probe(&audio);
41: 
42:   printf("vision_badge foundation 0.1.0\n");
43:   printf("board: BK7258 R1 / openvela\n");
44:   vision_badge_print_probe("camera", CONFIG_CONTEST2026_441_VISION_BADGE_CAMERA_DEVPATH,
45:                            &camera);
46:   vision_badge_print_probe("audio", CONFIG_CONTEST2026_441_VISION_BADGE_AUDIO_DEVPATH,
47:                            &audio);
48:   printf("cloud    pending  MiMo adapter is not implemented\n");
49:   printf("feedback console  enabled; audio/vibration pending\n");
50:   return 0;
51: }
52: 
53: static int vision_badge_selftest(void)
54: {
55:   struct vision_badge_context_s context = {VISION_BADGE_STAGE_IDLE, 0};
56:   int ret;
57: 
58:   ret = vision_badge_run_once(&context, NULL, NULL, NULL);
59:   if (ret != -EINVAL || strcmp(vision_badge_stage_name(context.stage), "idle") != 0)
60:     {
61:       fprintf(stderr, "vision_badge: contract selftest failed\n");
62:       return EXIT_FAILURE;
63:     }
64: 
65:   printf("vision_badge: contract selftest passed\n");
66:   return EXIT_SUCCESS;
67: }
68: 
69: static int vision_badge_run(const char *prompt)
70: {
71:   struct vision_badge_context_s context = {VISION_BADGE_STAGE_IDLE, 0};
72:   struct vision_badge_image_s image = {0};
73:   struct vision_badge_result_s result = {0};
74:   int ret;
75: 
76:   image.capacity = CONFIG_CONTEST2026_441_VISION_BADGE_JPEG_BUFFER_SIZE;
77:   result.capacity = CONFIG_CONTEST2026_441_VISION_BADGE_RESULT_BUFFER_SIZE;
78:   image.data = malloc(image.capacity);
79:   result.text = malloc(result.capacity);
80:   if (image.data == NULL || result.text == NULL)
81:     {
82:       fprintf(stderr, "vision_badge: buffer allocation failed\n");
83:       free(image.data);
84:       free(result.text);
85:       return EXIT_FAILURE;
86:     }
87: 
88:   ret = vision_badge_run_once(&context, prompt, &image, &result);
89:   if (ret < 0)
90:     {
91:       fprintf(stderr, "vision_badge: stage=%s error=%d\n",
92:               vision_badge_stage_name(context.stage), ret);
93:     }
94: 
95:   free(image.data);
96:   free(result.text);
97:   return ret < 0 ? EXIT_FAILURE : EXIT_SUCCESS;
98: }
99: 
100: int main(int argc, char *argv[])
101: {
102:   if (argc < 2)
103:     {
104:       vision_badge_usage(argv[0]);
105:       return EXIT_FAILURE;
106:     }
107: 
108:   if (strcmp(argv[1], "status") == 0)
109:     {
110:       return vision_badge_status();
111:     }
112: 
113:   if (strcmp(argv[1], "selftest") == 0)
114:     {
115:       return vision_badge_selftest();
116:     }
117: 
118:   if (strcmp(argv[1], "run") == 0 && argc >= 3)
119:     {
120:       return vision_badge_run(argv[2]);
121:     }
122: 
123:   vision_badge_usage(argv[0]);
124:   return EXIT_FAILURE;
125: }

9:                              int error_code)
10: {
11:   context->last_error = error_code;
12:   return error_code;

15: int vision_badge_run_once(struct vision_badge_context_s *context,
16:                           const char *prompt,
17:                           struct vision_badge_image_s *image,
18:                           struct vision_badge_result_s *result)
19: {
20:   int ret;
21: 
22:   if (context == NULL || prompt == NULL || prompt[0] == '\0' ||
23:       image == NULL || result == NULL)
24:     {
25:       return -EINVAL;
26:     }
27: 
28:   context->stage = VISION_BADGE_STAGE_CAPTURE;
29:   context->last_error = 0;
30: 
31:   ret = camera_service_capture(image);
32:   if (ret < 0)
33:     {
34:       return vision_badge_fail(context, ret);
35:     }
36: 
37:   context->stage = VISION_BADGE_STAGE_QUERY;
38:   ret = vision_service_query(image, prompt, result);
39:   if (ret < 0)
40:     {
41:       return vision_badge_fail(context, ret);
42:     }
43: 
44:   context->stage = VISION_BADGE_STAGE_FEEDBACK;
45:   ret = feedback_service_present(result);
46:   if (ret < 0)
47:     {
48:       return vision_badge_fail(context, ret);
49:     }
50: 
51:   context->stage = VISION_BADGE_STAGE_DONE;
52:   return 0;
53: }
